column1: # THE GOOSE WIRE-FUZZ LEG'S KNOWN FINDINGS (make/goose-wirefuzz.sh). One row
# per arm that the differential holds red today, at the pinned seed and count
# make/goose-fuzz.mk runs: the unit, the arm, a substring of the harness's
# first divergence, and the card that owes the fix. A known arm that goes red
# on anything else, or goes GREEN, fails the gate: a fixed finding leaves this
# file in the same commit, so the list cannot rot into silence. The fuzzer
# stops an arm at its first divergence, so a known row also hides whatever
# that arm would have found after it; the fix's own run says what that is.
